about_the_game:
You’re just a small-town guy with big pastry dreams — and this summer, Paris is your playground.

As a baking apprentice in one of the city’s most iconic patisseries, you’ll whip up mouth-watering desserts, impress picky customers, and try to win the title of France’s top pastry chef. But it's not just about sugar and flour...

You’re living in a luxurious home owned by your wealthy (and very curious) distant relative, meeting gorgeous café regulars, and making choices that unlock romantic, steamy, and sometimes hilarious stories.

It’s a visual novel with a point-and-click twist, packed with flirty humor, summer vibes, and sweet adult content.

🍓 KEY FEATURES

🇫🇷 Pure Parisian Summer Vibes
Explore the sunny streets, cozy cafés, and secret corners of a romanticized, modern-day Paris.
🍰 Dessert-Making Mini-Games
Mix, bake, decorate — and impress! Your skills in the kitchen lead to more than just praise… they unlock deeper (and hotter) storylines.
💋 Branching Romance Paths
Meet unique girls with distinct personalities and backgrounds. Choose who to bond with — or chase them all.
🏡 Life at the Mansion
Living with your wealthy cousin? Expect surprises. Clean the house, do chores, or get into a little “trouble” after hours.
📖 Play Your Way
Focus on love, desserts, or both. Your choices unlock different scenes, routes, and endings. Discover every flavor of this naughty Parisian tale.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, or for viewing at work: sexual content, nudity. The game graphically depicts sex. All characters in the game are over the age of 18.
